description: Capacity record v1 (#13296, docs/deployment/soak.md): one night's soak of the full fleet, as the soak writes it, posts it to POST /api/playtest/capacity-record (signed as a room's `capacity` write), the API stores it whole and GET /api/playtest/capacity answers it. Text: a `capacity 1` line, then one `KEY VALUE` line for each field in order, every line always, a newline after the last. One codec, coax/web/api/soak-record.coax.
